What we do

Joinery built around your home

The bigger jobs are the heart of the work: kitchens, wardrobes, media walls and one-off builds. Doors, stairs, flooring and the smaller jobs are covered too.

01

Fitted Kitchens

New kitchens and utility rooms fitted square and level, from the base units and worktops to the wall cabinets and trim.

02

Media and Feature Walls

Framed media walls built around your TV and fire with the cables hidden, plus slatted and panelled feature walls.

Fitted Wardrobes

Floor to ceiling wardrobes, walk-in storage and dressing areas, made to measure for the room, alcoves and all.

Get a quote
04

Bespoke Builds

One-off cabinets, sideboards, built-in storage and panelling, designed for the space rather than bought off the shelf.

Renovations and Refits

Pergolas and Garden Builds

Real transformations

Project 01

Bathroom rebuilt from the floor up

The floor came up to the joists, with old pipework running through it. It was put right and boarded, then the room was finished with marble-effect wall panels, a new white suite and a dark plank floor.

Project 02

Downstairs toilet given a proper finish

Stripped back to bare walls and an open waste. Now a cream back to wall unit with the cistern boxed in, a dark marble-effect feature wall, a slim column radiator and a clean wood-effect floor.

Why choose us

Joinery done properly, start to finish

Good joinery shows in the details you notice later: doors that close square, panels that line up and a room left as clean as it was found.

Made to measure

Everything is measured and built for your room, so it fits the alcove, the slope or the awkward corner instead of fighting it.

Clear communication

You know what is happening and when. Questions get a straight answer, before the job starts and while it is under way.

Clean and tidy

Mess is cleared as the work goes, and the room is left clean and ready to use when the job is done.

Agreed up front

A clear quote and a timescale agreed before the work starts, so you know what you are paying and when it will be finished.

The bigger jobs

Full kitchens, media walls, fitted wardrobes and one-off builds, as well as the doors, floors and panelling around them.

Local to Pontefract

Based in Pontefract and working across West Yorkshire, so you deal with the two people who will actually do the work.

Meet the team

LGJ Joinery & Building Services

A Pontefract based joinery partnership run by Louie and Leo, working across West Yorkshire and the surrounding areas.

Most of the work is the bigger joinery: fitted kitchens, wardrobes, media walls and bespoke builds, alongside the doors, floors, stud walls and panelling that come with any refurb. Every job is planned with the homeowner, done to a high standard and finished clean and tidy.
